messages.text: Hi! Is there a list of "good first issues" on Ergo?

I am aware of the bounty list (https://github.com/ErgoDevs/Ergo-Bounties/blob/main/data/all.md), but it seems that it is mostly for harder issues that people have struggled to solve (and therefore a bounty is needed for someone who manages to solve them).

"Good first issues" on the other hand would be simpler issues that someone less familiarized with the code but willing to contribute would be able to take up.
